content.comment_body: While attempting to download a PLC program to [product_name], I encounter an error stating "Blocks without connection to an output." The issue involves Message Texts and an Analog Amplifier. [product_name] has a local display and a TDE module attached. I have set up the device for two analog inputs (I7/I8).

In [product_name], all blocks that are used must be connected to outputs or other valid destinations. You can link them to outputs, other blocks, flags (markers), or open connectors. Within [product_name]-Soft, pressing F2 highlights open connections.
What is the method for connecting 'Message Texts' to an output?
If the output of a text block isn't utilized, it's possible to link it to a marker or an open connector.

analysis.insight_summary: A user experiences an error when trying to download a PLC program onto [product_name] due to blocks, such as 'Message Texts' and Analog Amplifiers, not being properly connected to an output or valid destination. The platform enforces that all blocks must have appropriate connections, yet guidance on how to do this—especially with less typical blocks—is unclear. This indicates a need for improved documentation or usability in the connection process within the tool.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes the programming environment will either handle block connections automatically or provide clear instructions for connecting all block types, including 'Message Texts', to valid destinations. Their expectation is for a more straightforward workflow where such errors are easily avoided or quickly resolved within the software.
